title: Sephora UK MD on 2027 expansion plans and the M&S store partnership: ‘Now we want proximity’
summary: Hot off hosting its beauty festival, Sephoria, in the UK for the first time, UK MD Sarah Boyd reveals the retailer’s 2027 expansion plans for the region, including a third boutique, more large-format stores, and what Sephora’s upcoming shop-in-shop concept with British multinational retailer Marks & Spencer (M&S) will actually entail

extraction.key_fact: 세포라 영국이 내년 매장 확장과 M&S 숍인숍 계획을 밝혔다.
